labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE: patched FS-UAE 3.2.35 (build-fsuae-native.sh — mousehack re-arm) runs on the host inside a pinned Xvfb :58 sized to the emulator window; the daemon captures the X root (SH_CAPTURE=x11) and injects input over XTEST (SH_X11TEST_ABS/_BUTTONS/_KEYS). No QEMU/QMP, no guest Linux, no exec channel. Reset=relaunch: fresh work HDF reflinked from disk/amigaos35-system.hdf.golden + --load_state of sta/'Saved State 1.uss' + FS_UAE_MOUSEHACK_ADDR re-arm (the addr is PAIRED with the statefile). Launcher stations/a3000/x11-runtime.sh.

museum.arch: Motorola 68030 @ 16 MHz + 68882 FPU, ECS chipset, 2 MB chip + 8 MB fast RAM
museum.periodBrowser: none — this machine predates the web, and the exhibit is not networked
museum.blurb: Commodore's 1990 flagship: a 68030 with its memory management unit fitted, a floating-point unit, SCSI on the motherboard and a flicker fixer, in a low desktop case. It booted Workbench 2.04 — the rewrite that gave AmigaOS its grey three-dimensional look, a usable Shell and a standard Installer — and, as the Amiga 3000UX, the same machine ran Amiga UNIX, the amix exhibit next door.
museum.notes: Host-native from birth: FS-UAE 3.2.35 (A3000 model, 68030 + 68882, ECS, Kickstart 2.04 r37.175 A3000 ROM) under a pinned Xvfb :89, x11 root capture + XTEST input, same backend as amigaos35. Media: the KS 2.04 A3000 ROM (the one amix already stages) + the four Workbench 2.04 rev 37.67 ADFs from archive.org (preservation-class, never committed), composed host-side with amitools xdftool into an FFS hardfile as amigaos35 does for 3.1. Reset = relaunch: a cold boot of a fresh work HDF copied from the golden. Between amiga (A500 / 1.3) and amigaos35 (A4000 / 3.5) in the lineup, and the machine amix (Amiga UNIX) shares. See docs/guests/a3000.md.

reset.fixture: Workbench 2.04 desktop (grey 2.0 look, 640x256 PAL in a 720x568 window) booted from the host-composed FFS hardfile: Ram Disk + System disk icons, no windows open, no first-boot keymap prompt (the floppy's startup-sequence runs one; the HDF's does not). resetMode=relaunch with no statefile: every launch copies disk/a3000-system.hdf.golden to work/ and cold-boots.
